title: The moment the conversation changes
banner: Fictional conversation. Use live analysis to interpret the indirect follow-up; fixture replay checks patterns only.
whatItShows: Find a published role without a requisition, then trace an indirect transfer request back to the message where it first appeared.
text: Synthetic recruiting conversation: I am contacting you about the Software Engineer Intern (Summer 2027) role at Figma in San Francisco. We will send funds for your workstation.
followUpText: Keep 200 and transfer the remainder to our supplier.
